flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi framework/workflows/agencies/toppan/upload (ToppanStage, ToppanLettersGeneratorJob), framework/schedulers/{ToppanUploadJobsScheduler,NotificationJobsScheduler}, framework/controllers/ToppanUnifiedController, framework/workflows/notification_sms_email/{helpers/NotificationSmsEmailHelper,jobs/NotificationSmsEmailJob}, application-prod.properties, cron-schedules-prod.properties. ocmsadminapi crud/ocmsizdb/enotificationexclusion, api-authorization.properties. ocmsadminui pages/ENotifExclusion, pages/Cron/list/CronList.tsx, App.tsx. ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: no related code
note: The story asks that an officer can enable/disable the sending of letter reminders and electronic reminders per notice type. The sheet status 'Fully paid' is not supported by the code for the configuration part. The sending mechanisms exist (Toppan for RD1..DR3, SMS/email for ENA and RD1..DR3), but there is no enable/disable switch the officer can set and no notice type filter: the only switches are deployment properties (cron.toppanupload.enabled, cron.notification.enabled, sms.enable, email.enableSmtp, sftp.upload.disabledServers), which are global and need a server configuration change/deployment. What exists in the portal is only (a) the Cron page with Run now buttons, not switches, and (b) the E-Notification Exclusion list per ID No (not per notice type, stage or channel). In the prod properties: cron.notification.enabled=false, sms.enable=false, email.enableSmtp=false, sftp.upload.disabledServers=toppan, and the Toppan executeJob() call in the day-end scheduler is commented out, so in the repo every reminder sending is either disabled or manual. Real server values: cannot verify from repo. The exclusion list is fail-open: if reading fails the list is empty and everyone is sent to.
recommendation: Do not claim the per-notice-type enable/disable configuration. Only the sending mechanisms, the manual buttons on the Cron page and the per-ID exclusion list can be shown. Ask URA/the team to confirm whether switches through properties and the per-ID exclusion list are accepted for this story, or mark it as a gap

steps.step: Letter reminders (RD1, RD2, RR3, DN1, DN2, DR3) are generated and sent to Toppan
steps.detail: The generator job processes every stage of the ToppanStage enum (RD1, RD2, RR3, DN1, DN2, DR3, ANL; ToppanLettersGeneratorJob.java:151-156, ToppanStage.java:19-25). But the call toppanLettersGeneratorService.executeJob() in executeDayEndJobs is commented out (ToppanUploadJobsScheduler.java:118), so letters are generated only through the manual trigger POST /toppan/generate-letters (ToppanUnifiedController.java:34), which appears in the staff portal as the 'Toppan Generate Letters' button on the Cron page (CronList.tsx:45). In prod sftp.upload.disabledServers=toppan (application-prod.properties:86), so the upload to Toppan is switched off and the delivery gate is bypassed (OCMS-DF-2026-192, Ready to UAT). Real server value: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: The officer can enable/disable the sending of letter reminders from the portal
steps.detail: There is no switch an officer can change. The only flag is the deployment property cron.toppanupload.enabled=true (cron-schedules-prod.properties:61-62), global for the whole day-end job and not per stage or notice type. Property toppan.unified.process.all.stages (ToppanLettersGeneratorJob.java:59-60) only appears in the job summary (ToppanLettersGeneratorJob.java:112) and filters no stage. The Cron page in the staff portal only holds trigger buttons (CronList.tsx:41-67), with no enable/disable toggle. There is no endpoint or settings table for this in ocmsadminapi.

steps.step: Letter reminder sending can be set per notice type
steps.detail: The letter loop always runs over all ToppanStage values with no notice type parameter or filter (ToppanLettersGeneratorJob.java:151-156). The notice filtering in ToppanUploadHelper uses stage, vehicle type (foreign, military, diplomatic; ToppanUploadHelper.java:1974-2002) and address availability, not offence_notice_type (grep offence_notice_type in ToppanUploadHelper.java is empty). No table or parameter stores a sending flag per notice type.

steps.step: Electronic reminders (SMS and email) are sent for stage ENA and RD1 to DR3
steps.detail: The ENA query (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:992-1000) and the reminder query for stages RD1, RD2, RR3, DN1, DN2, DR3 (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1076-1114) select notices that are due for SMS/email. But the EMAIL channel is skipped for stages DN1, DN2, DR3 because no template is available (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:313-316). In prod cron.notification.enabled=false (cron-schedules-prod.properties:234-236; checked in NotificationJobsScheduler.java:49-54), sms.enable=false (application-prod.properties:87) and email.enableSmtp=false (application-prod.properties:80), so sending is disabled in the repo. The job can only run through the 'ENA Reminder' button on the Cron page (CronList.tsx:47). Real server values: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: The officer can exclude recipients from electronic reminders through the exclusion list
steps.detail: The E-Notification Exclusion page (App.tsx:302-309) stores ID No and remarks (ExclusionForm.tsx:144-162) through the enotificationexclusion endpoints (create, list, patch, delete; EnotificationExclusionController.java:50,87,102,166; function OCMS_ENOTIF_EXCLUSION in api-authorization.properties:156). The notification job loads that list and skips recipients in it; for ENA, an opted-out recipient is moved to the RD1 letter track (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:194, 226-228). The limit: the exclusion is per person (ID No), not per notice type, stage or channel, so it is not 'enable/disable per notice type'. loadAllExcludedIds returns an empty set when the query fails (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1207-1216), so a read failure means everyone is still sent to (fail-open). Because the notification cron is off in prod, the effect on the server: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: Electronic reminder sending can be enabled or disabled per notice type
steps.detail: The recipient selection queries use a hardcoded stage list (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1114) and a vehicle_registration_type NOT IN ('I','D','V') filter (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1061, 1151), not the notice type. The only switch is cron.notification.enabled in properties (NotificationJobsScheduler.java:30-31), global for all notice types. No table or parameter holds a flag per notice type.
